prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。

wrong.I have seen: Never 放在句首要倒裝，助動詞 have 要放在主詞前面。
wrong.I saw: Never 放句首時一定要倒裝，而且一般語序的 I saw 沒有倒裝。

why: 否定副詞 never 在句首，後面用倒裝：助動詞 + 主詞。
say: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: Only after the rain stopped _____ go out.

wrong.we could: Only after 開頭的句子要倒裝，助動詞 could 要放在主詞前面。
wrong.we can: 時態應與 stopped 一致用過去式，而且也需要倒裝。

why: Only + 時間副詞片語在句首，主句要倒裝。
tip: only after 放句首，主句倒裝。
say: Only after the rain stopped could we go out.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？

rarely 放句首，是否定副詞，主詞和助動詞要倒裝。
助動詞 does 已經帶有第三人稱單數，後面動詞要用原形 eat。

why: Rarely 在句首時用 does he + 原形動詞。
tip: 倒裝句的主要動詞用原形。

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。

wrong.does come: Here 開頭的地方副詞倒裝，直接把動詞放在主詞前，不用助動詞。
wrong.come: 主詞 the bus 是單數，動詞要用 comes。

why: Here comes the bus 是地方副詞倒裝，主詞是單數所以用 comes。
tip: Here 開頭，動詞要與後面主詞一致。

prompt: 你想說「他一到家，就開始下雨了」。哪一句最合適？
options: No sooner had he arrived home than it began to rain.
No sooner he had arrived home than it began to rain.
No sooner had he arrived home when it began to rain.
answer: No sooner had he arrived home than it began to rain.

wrong.No sooner he had arrived home than it be: No sooner 放句首要倒裝，had 要放在 he 前面。
wrong.No sooner had he arrived home when it be: No sooner 要搭配 than，不是 when；Hardly 才搭配 when。

why: No sooner + had + 主詞 + p.p. + than 是固定句型。
tip: no sooner 搭配 than，hardly 搭配 when。
say: No sooner had he arrived home than it began to rain.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。

wrong.he finished: Not until 放句首時，主句要倒裝。
wrong.he did finish: 助動詞 did 要放在主詞 he 的前面，不是後面。

why: Not until 引導的片語在句首，主句倒裝。
tip: not until 放句首，主句倒裝。
say: Not until midnight did he finish the work.

prompt: 這個句子的意思是什麼？
text: Little did she know that the gift was from Ben.
options: 她完全不知道禮物是 Ben 送的
她知道一點禮物是 Ben 送的
她很少收到 Ben 的禮物
answer: 她完全不知道禮物是 Ben 送的

wrong.她知道一點禮物是 Ben 送的: little 放句首是否定的意思，表示完全不知道，不是「一點點」。
wrong.她很少收到 Ben 的禮物: 句子重點在 know，不是 receive 的頻率。

why: Little 放在句首時有否定意味，後面倒裝，意思是「完全不知道」。
tip: 句首的 little 是否定，要倒裝。
say: Little did she know that the gift was from Ben.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Not only is she smart, but she is also kind.
Not only she is smart, but she is also kind.
Not only is she smart, but is she also kind.
answer: Not only is she smart, but she is also kind.

wrong.Not only she is smart, but she is also k: Not only 在句首，後面要倒裝成 is she。
wrong.Not only is she smart, but is she also k: 只有 Not only 後面倒裝，but also 後面保持一般語序。

why: Not only 放句首，只在這一半倒裝。
tip: Not only 倒裝，but also 不倒裝。
say: Not only is she smart, but she is also kind.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: In front of the school _____ a tall old tree.

wrong.stand: 主詞 a tall old tree 是單數，動詞要用 stands。
wrong.does stand: 地方副詞倒裝時，直接把動詞放在主詞前，不用助動詞 does。

why: 地方副詞片語放句首，不及物動詞與主詞倒裝：stands a tall old tree。
tip: 地方副詞倒裝，動詞與後面主詞一致。
say: In front of the school stands a tall old tree.

prompt: 你想說「任何情況下，你都不該把孩子獨自留下」。哪一句最合適？
options: Under no circumstances should you leave the children alone.
Under no circumstances you should leave the children alone.
Under no circumstances should not you leave the children alone.
answer: Under no circumstances should you leave the children alone.

wrong.Under no circumstances you should leave: Under no circumstances 在句首，後面要把 should 放在 you 前面。
wrong.Under no circumstances should not you le: no 已經是否定，再加 not 變成雙重否定，語意也錯。

why: 否定的片語在句首，主句倒裝，不能再加 not。
tip: 句首已否定，後面不再加 not。
say: Under no circumstances should you leave the children alone.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: Hardly had we reached the station _____ the train left.

wrong.than: than 搭配 No sooner，不搭配 Hardly。
wrong.that: 這個句型的固定搭配是 hardly … when，不用 that。

why: Hardly had + 主詞 + p.p. + when，表示「一…就…」。
tip: hardly 搭配 when，no sooner 搭配 than。
say: Hardly had we reached the station when the train left.

prompt: 這個句子的意思是什麼？
text: Only by working together can we win.
options: 只有透過合作，我們才能贏
answer: 只有透過合作，我們才能贏

wrong.單獨工作我們才能贏: working together 是一起合作，與單獨工作相反。
wrong.我們贏了，所以才合作: 句子說的是合作是贏的條件，不是贏之後才合作。

why: Only by ... 放句首，表示唯一的方法，後面倒裝。
tip: Only by 加 V-ing，表示唯有靠…。
say: Only by working together can we win.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: So tired was he that he fell asleep at once.
So tired he was that he fell asleep at once.
So was tired he that he fell asleep at once.
answer: So tired was he that he fell asleep at once.

wrong.So tired he was that he fell asleep at o: So + 形容詞放句首，後面主詞與 be 動詞要倒裝成 was he。
wrong.So was tired he that he fell asleep at o: 順序錯誤，倒裝句的順序是 So + 形容詞 + be + 主詞。

why: So + 形容詞開頭的句子倒裝：So tired was he。
tip: So 加形容詞開頭，後接 be 加主詞。
say: So tired was he that he fell asleep at once.
